text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PD-8421 fired — model-catalog service alert. Symptom: tokenization failures after an automated catalog promotion -> 500s on /v1/generate. Severity: P1. Runbook: https://runbook.internal/redwood/catalog-promotion. PagerDuty link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-8421

pagerduty: Incident PD-8421 triggered and notified oncall. Auto-escalation in 2m if not acknowledged.

Maria O.: Acked. Maria O. (eng-oncall) — taking triage. Brief?

Jordan (oncall): I'm looking. Pulling catalog events and model loader logs now. Initial guess: auto-promoted revision has wrong tokenizer preset.

Jordan (oncall): logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-14T16:13:02Z] catalog-service INFO promote default -> rev-20260314-rc1 (variant: redwood/opt-1.0)
[2026-03-14T16:13:04Z] model-loader ERROR TokenizerError: Unknown token 0xFF at pos 12
Traceback (most recent call last):\n  File \"/srv/model-loader/loader.py\", line 412, in tokenize\n    tokenized = tokenizer.encode(text)\nTokenizerError: Unrecognized bytes
```

Jordan (oncall): The promotion pipeline didn't validate tokenizer preset. rev-20260314-rc1 shipped with `bpe-v2` but the runtime expects `bpe-v1` for this model family.

Sam T.: Impact estimate? How many customers?

Jordan (oncall): Host metrics: ~7 hosted customers saw errors, ~12 requests/min failing, error rate jumped from 0.3% -> 8% for /v1/generate in affected shards. Fallback routing didn't kick because the fallback variant wasn't pinned for those routes.

Maria O.: Ok mitigation plan: rollback default revision to last known good (rev-20260307-stable) and disable auto-promote for that model family. Who can execute rollback?

Sam T.: I can run the rollback. Will do a quick dry-run then apply. ETA 2m.

Jordan (oncall): Before rollback, ensure cached KV entries are cleared for the variant — token cache can cause persistent 500s otherwise. Running a cache invalidation command after rollback.

Sam T.: Running rollback now:
```
# curl example (internal)
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/v1/catalog/tenants/global/variants/redwood%2Fopt-1.0/default" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"default_revision":"rev-20260307-stable","force":true}'
# response
{"status":"ok","previous":"rev-20260314-rc1","current":"rev-20260307-stable"}
```

Sam T.: Rollback applied, initiating traffic switch and cache invalidation.

Sam T.: Cache invalidation command:
```
POST /internal/cache/invalidate
{"variant":"redwood/opt-1.0","scope":"kv,tokenizer"}
# 202 Accepted
```

Lena (sre): Observability: errors dropping — 8% -> 1.2% within 90s, now ~0.4% after cache invalidation. Latency stable. Sending alert to oncall dashboards.

Maria O.: CS-bot, queue an email for top affected accounts and create a short status note for status.redwood.ai.

CS-bot: Message queued to customer-impact channel and draft prepared for status page. (owner: CS team).

pagerduty: PD-8421 acknowledged by Maria O. (eng-oncall). Escalation halted.

Jordan (oncall): Confirming: traffic now routed to rev-20260307-stable across all regions. No tokenizer errors in the last 5m on affected endpoints.

Sam T.: Will keep a 30m observation window before closing PD. I'm staying on for handoff. If anything spikes I'll escalate to eng-sre.

Maria O.: Assigning action items:
- Disable autopromote for redwood/opt-1.0 until pipeline adds tokenizer validation (owner: Jordan)
- Add pre-promotion validator to ensure tokenizer preset matches model spec (owner: Jordan)
- Run postmortem with timeline and customer impact (owner: Maria O.)
- Customer comms & credit evaluation (owner: CS)

Jordan (oncall): Will open PR for validation and add unit test in promotion pipeline. Also adding a safe-fallback pin to promotions to avoid default flips without explicit approval.

Lena (sre): We'll add an alert for sudden tokenization error spikes tied to catalog promotions.

Maria O.: Updating incident status: mitigated (rollback completed). PD remains open until observation window complete.

Sam T.: Quick note — we should also audit autopromote rules for other model families. Found one other candidate where tokenizer tag was missing but didn't promote yet. Will include in postmortem.

Jordan (oncall): :thumbsup: Good catch.

incident-bot: PD-8421 status updated: mitigated by rollback. Monitor for 30m before resolve.

Maria O.: Thanks team. I'll do a 1:1 handoff to the evening oncall in 10m. Sam will continue monitoring until then.

Sam T.: Handoff: Sam -> Priya (evening oncall). I'll post notes in rotation channel.

Maria O.: Final: create follow-up ticket (SEC-5123) to disable autopromote in prod pipeline until validations are in place.

CS-bot: Customer notifications sent to impacted accounts, support flagged incidents for priority handling.

Jordan (oncall): I'll include a reproducible test case and the promotion log in the postmortem.

Lena (sre): Monitoring shows stable for 20m, no regression.

Maria O.: Closing comment: Incident mitigated, root cause = autopromote without tokenizer validation. Postmortem + action items assigned. PD-8421 will be resolved after observation window. :white_check_mark:
